name: Baldy Peak
summary: Del Norte County, CA summit lookout house, called a Forest Service lookout house in 1941; a 1977 USGS note says it was destroyed and only the floor remained. FFLA lists it gone.
design: Ground-level lookout house on the summit (FFLA list: Ground)
status_note: 1977 USGS recovery note says the lookout house was destroyed and only the floor remained; FFLA list marks it Gone with no date
agency: Six Rivers National Forest (Forest Lookouts lists Siskiyou National Forest first, then Six Rivers)

access.note: Reached on the Forest Service South Kelsey Trail #4E06; no closure stated in the sources read. No lookout structure to visit.

visit.trail_note: Hike the South Kelsey Trail #4E06: about 8 miles along the South Fork of the Smith River, then about 5 miles of steep climbing to Baldy Peak. The route beyond Harrington Creek has not been maintained for several years.

events.note: May 1940 planning note for the point: needed only in the normal lightning season
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description (1941) calls the summit building a U.S. Forest Service lookout house
USGS recovery note: the lookout house has been destroyed and all that remains is the floor
